items.summaryEn:
Each week in Austin, @nogirlwalksalone brings a community together.
Tonight we’re walking alongside them, so that anyone curious about F1 can meet the team, share stories and see our world up close.
#USGP
detailZh:
在奥斯汀的每周，@nogirlwalksalone 将社区聚集在一起。
今晚，我们将与他们同行，让任何对F1感兴趣的人都能见到车队，分享故事，并近距离看到我们的世界。
detailEn:
Each week in Austin, @nogirlwalksalone brings a community together.
Tonight we’re walking alongside them, so that anyone curious about F1 can meet the team, share stories and see our world up close.
#USGP

items.titleZh: Lady Bird Lake上的社区划船活动
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁 F1在Lady Bird Lake举办社区划船活动，并与参与者分享赛车周的故事。

media.altZh: Lady Bird Lake上的社区划船活动 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Every day on Lady Bird Lake, @RowingDock gets a community out on the water. Last night they let us join in. We paddled, talked and shared a little of ...
items.summaryEn:
Every day on Lady Bird Lake, @RowingDock gets a community out on the water.
Last night they let us join in. We paddled, talked and shared a little of race week from the inside, before ATX Yoga Girl closed the evening with a soundbath.
Thank you for letting us be part of it. #USGP
detailZh:
每天在Lady Bird Lake上，@RowingDock让社区的人们在水中活动。
昨晚他们允许我们加入。我们划桨、交谈，并分享了一些关于赛车周的内部信息，然后ATX Yoga Girl用声音浴结束了这个夜晚。
感谢你们让我们成为其中的一部分。#USGP
detailEn:
Every day on Lady Bird Lake, @RowingDock gets a community out on the water.
Last night they let us join in. We paddled, talked and shared a little of race week from the inside, before ATX Yoga Girl closed the evening with a soundbath.
Thank you for letting us be part of it. #USGP

items.titleZh: 采用AI是一回事，充分利用它则是另一回事
items.summaryZh: 阿斯顿·马丁与Cognizant合作五年，成为全球AI服务合作伙伴，共同探索了团队运营的转型和与I/AM会员的更紧密联系。
items.originalTitle: Adopting AI is one thing; getting the most out of it is another. Five years into our partnership, @Cognizant has become our Global AI Services Partner...
items.summaryEn:
Adopting AI is one thing; getting the most out of it is another. 
Five years into our partnership, @Cognizant has become our Global AI Services Partner. Thea Hayden and David Ingham explore what we've achieved together and what comes next, from transforming team operations to bringing us closer to our I / AM members. 
Read more: https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/perspectives-thea-hayden-and-david-ingham
detailZh:
采用人工智能是一回事；充分利用它则是另一回事。
在我们的合作进入第五个年头时，@Cognizant 已经成为我们的全球人工智能服务合作伙伴。Thea Hayden 和 David Ingham 探讨了我们共同取得的成就以及接下来会发生什么，从改变团队运营到让我们与 I / AM 会员更加接近。
阅读更多：https://www.astonmartinf1.com/en-GB/news/feature/perspectives-thea-hayden-and-david-ingham
